claims.claim: Pristine UK direct PS4 slim console
claims.evidence: Witness only identifies a generic game console with PlayStation-style controller; no model label, region sticker, or UK import marks are visible.
No power-on test, boot screen, or gameplay clip shown.
Only one wireless controller is visible in the report.
Internal casing/screws not shown; plastic wrap only covers exterior, no teardown view.
Requires a running session or thermal/fan noise check, not available from a still photo.
Ports (USB, HDMI, LAN, power) are visible but not tested with a connected device.
No receipt or paperwork is shown in the photo.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may fault during use
risks.proof: Video clip of console powering on to the home screen and running a game briefly

risks.risk: Hidden scratches, cracks, or discoloration under the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the casing with wrap fully removed, all sides
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically worn, not pristine

risks.risk: Second controller claimed but not shown
risks.proof: Photo showing both controllers together with console

risks.risk: Unknown storage capacity (500GB vs 1TB) affecting value
No original box or packaging shown, affecting resale value and authenticity claim of 'UK direct'
risks.proof: Photo of original box with UK retailer markings

risks.risk: Region lock or firmware version could limit disc/game compatibility
risks.proof: Screenshot of system information menu showing region/firmware

risks.risk: Controller battery or charging port condition unverified
risks.proof: Clip showing controller charging and functioning with all buttons responsive
risks.if_unproven: priced as controller of unknown battery health

proof_requests: Video of console powering on and loading a game
Full set of photos with plastic wrap removed showing all casing surfaces
Photo of both controllers together if two are included
Screenshot of system storage capacity and firmware/region info
Photo of original UK box and the UK purchase receipt
Clip of controller charging and button response test
response.reason: The item type (PS4-style console with one controller) is settled by the witness, but working condition, authenticity (UK/pristine), and second controller are unverified or contradicted, so it must be priced at worst case pending further proof.
